# Positive control for gitleaks (tests/unit/test_gitleaks_fixtures.py).
#
# Repository-safe: this is AWS's own publicly documented example access key
# ID, used throughout AWS's docs and SDKs specifically as a non-functional
# placeholder (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_access-keys.html).
# It is not, and has never been, a live credential for any account. It is
# real-shaped enough to trip gitleaks' aws-access-token rule, which is the
# point: this fixture proves the hook actually fires (and redacts the
# match) on a plausible secret, rather than only on paths intentionally
# left out of .gitleaks.toml's allowlist.
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
